transferable_lessons: Target avoidable short-lived applications rather than every polymer use.
Build reuse logistics, sanitation standards, and convenient return before imposing scale targets.
Use deposits and producer responsibility to fund high capture.
Pair restrictions with narrow safety and no-viable-alternative exemptions.
Measure water, energy, product loss, litter, toxicity, cost, and equity instead of reporting item counts alone.
